How to play

1 · Tap a cell — pick an empty square on the board.

2 · Tap a number — fill it in. Every row, column, and 3×3 box needs 1–9 exactly once.

3 · Notes — pencil in candidates when you’re not sure yet.

4 · Hint — stuck? A hint fills one cell, but costs points.

5 · Erase & Undo — clear a cell, or take back your last move.

6 · Spirit fighters — win a puzzle and a spirit animal — wolf, panther, or tiger — marks the win with a three-second demonstration, strike flowing into a defensive stance. Pick your fighter in Settings; Dragon is exclusive to the Gilded bundle.

The game

A sudoku board with a porcelain finish.

The grid is glazed ceramic: bright white tiles with a soft sheen, ink-black givens, and gold doing the quiet work — box lines, highlights, the number you just placed. Underneath sits a full game loop: points for every cell, streaks that multiply them, a daily puzzle, weekly goals, gold milestone badges, and ranks that climb from Clay to Gold Master. The phone on the left is live: pick a difficulty and play it.

The palette

Three difficulties

Easy

Plenty of numbers on the board. Solvable with the basics — scanning rows, columns, and boxes.

~38 givens
Normal

Thinner board. Pairs and pointing start to matter; notes earn their keep.

~30 givens
Advanced

Sparse and stubborn. Built for the harder techniques — no guessing your way out.

~24 givens

Scoring

Every correct cell pays, and the tier sets the rate. Mistakes break your streak; hints are a trade-off, not a freebie — each one is bought with points.

Correct cell — Easy / Normal / Advanced10 / 25 / 50 pts
Streak multiplier×1 to ×5
Time bonus — per second under par2 / 3 / 5 pts
No-mistake bonus200 / 500 / 1,000 pts
Hint cost−30 / −75 / −150 pts

Correct cells in a row build the streak: every 4 in a row raises the multiplier a step, up to ×5. Par is 5 minutes on Easy, 10 on Normal, 15 on Advanced — finish faster and the leftover seconds pay out.

The streak has a sound. The second correct cell in a row chimes; the third climbs a note higher, the fourth higher still — each one up the scale, with a small flourish when the multiplier steps up. A mistake drops a low thud and resets the climb. The Sound button beside Pause mutes it all.

Milestones

Your fastest finish on each tier is kept too — it shows under the badges on the phone, and every new record quietly raises the bar for the next one.

Try it: place numbers and watch the score climb — chain correct cells to raise the streak multiplier and hear the chime climb a note with each one in a row, and notice what a hint costs you. Finish a puzzle and a spirit animal — wolf, panther, or tiger — marks the win with a three-second demonstration, strike flowing into a defensive stance, before the full score breakdown, your first badge, and the start of the climb from Clay. Everything saves on this device as you play — close the page mid-puzzle and you’ll come back to the same board, score, streak, and timer.
